description: This file extends the version 2 registry class for SuiteCRM, specifically for version 3. It defines a class 'registry_v3' that registers multiple web service functions and complex data types related to module data, user activities, and relationships within the SuiteCRM application. This includes method registration for fetching module fields, available modules, last viewed items, upcoming activities, search functionalities, and relationships, as well as defining associated complex SOAP types.

classes.name: registry_v3
classes.description: A class extending the v2 registry to add SOAP web service functions and data types for SuiteCRM version 3.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers various web service functions for SuiteCRM version 3, including module field retrieval, module listing, last viewed items, upcoming activities, search, and relationships.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex SOAP data types used by the web services, such as results arrays, module name lists, upcoming activities, last viewed entries, and field structures.
